senses.gloss: ch. sameto contract, detain; to reduce a swelling.—
units: <cite ref="Chullin 93b:6">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>מִצְמַת צָמְתֵי ליה</he> they have the effect of condensing the surface of the flesh (binding the blood in the veins).
<cite ref="Shabbat 109a:5">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>קא צמית ליה בחלא</he> was bathing his foot in vinegar (on the Sabbath) to reduce the swelling; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:9">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ</cite> top <he>גזר עליהון וצָמְתוּן</he> he conjured them (the mice), and they came together.

senses.gloss: to assemble, call, summon to a meeting. Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ top מַצְמֵית וכ׳ (or מְצַמֵּית), v. סְכַן II. Y. Succ. V, beg. 55ᵃ ר׳ לוי … מיעול מְצַמְּתָא קהלא וכ׳ R. L. and R. J. … received (alternately) two Selas to go around and call the congregation together for R. J. (to listen to his lecture); Gen. R. s. 98 למצמתא (not צמצ׳).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>עד … מצמית לון</he> while he was collecting them (picking up the scattered loaves). Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ bot. <he>אזל וצַמֵּת ליה וכ׳</he> he (Absalom) went and summoned (to accompany him) two men at a time, until he had collected two hundred men; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:24">Num. R. s. 9</cite>. Y. Kidd. IV, end, 66ᵈ <he>ומצמית ליה פריטין</he> and saved a little money.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>יומא דהוו מִצְטַמְּתִין קמת וכ׳</he> Ar. (missing in ed.) on that day when the Korahites were to meet, she (On’s wife) arose and gave him wine to drink &c.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) <he>אִצְטְמִיתִינָן</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="R00586"><he>צַמְצֵם</he></cite>.
